- bilingual: Read the README (fetch raw content of README.md or similar). Does it contain meaningful content in both English and French? Look for French words/phrases, French section headers, or a clear French translation. Allowed values: "Yes", "No", "Unknown".
- readme_clarity: Read the README. Does it clearly explain what the project is, who it's for, and how to use it? Allowed: "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Unknown".
- security_policy: Check for `SECURITY.md` in the root, `.github/`, and `docs/` directories. If not found, write "Missing". If found, read it. If it contains real responsible disclosure instructions (contact info, how to report, PGP key, etc.), write "Present". If it exists but is just a placeholder or links without real instructions, write "Incomplete". Allowed: "Present", "Incomplete", "Missing", "Unknown".
- issue_response_quality: Look at the 5 most recently updated open issues (API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/caf-tg/issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=5`). Filter out pull requests (skip items with `pull_request` key). For each issue, check the comments (API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/caf-tg/issues/{number}/comments`). Determine if anyone other than the original reporter commented within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13). If at least one issue has such a comment, write "Active". If none, write "Stale". If there are no open issues (after filtering out PRs), write "No Issues". Allowed: "Active", "Stale", "No Issues", "Unknown".
- release_notes_quality: Check the Releases page via API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/caf-tg/releases` or HTML. If no releases, write "No Releases". If releases exist, check the latest few (up to 3). If the description actually explains what changed (e.g., bullet points, changelog), write "Detailed". If it's just a version number or tag with no description, write "Version-only". Allowed: "Detailed", "Version-only", "No Releases", "Unknown".

Important:
- Use ONLY the exact allowed values for each field.
- If you cannot determine a value, write exactly "Unknown".
- Prefer public HTML page scraping over GitHub API where possible to avoid rate limits. If using API, add `sleep 1` between requests.
- Write the final JSON object to `/workspace/manual_caf-tg.json` and also return the JSON content in your final message.
